## 4.3.0

### English

Stable release of the **4.3** product line (promoted from 4.3-rc1).

**Highlights**

- **Faster Odoo platform cloning** — shallow clone by branch, commit, or limited depth (saves up to ~40 minutes on large histories). See [Git repository links](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/git-links/) and [`deps.lock.json`](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/deps-lock/).
- **`uv` on Debian 12+** in container images instead of plain `pip` — much faster package installs (up to ~10×). See [developer scenario](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/scenarios/developer/).
- **Configurable Odoo platform source** — custom git URL when not set defaults to official Odoo GitHub. See [Custom Odoo platform repo](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/scenarios/platform-fork/) and [`odoo_git_link` in odpm.json](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/odpm-json/).
- **Dry-run (`odpm plan`)** — preview what will change before a full run. See [Command-line options](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/cli/).
- **Multiple debugger backends** — VS Code / Cursor and **PyCharm** (Attach to DAP and Debug Server). See [IDE debugging](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/operations/vscode-debug/).
- **`${VAR}` substitution in manifest** — environment variables in settings (especially useful for `file://` paths). See [odpm.json](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/odpm-json/), [`.env` variables](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/env-dotenv/), [Git links](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/git-links/).
- **Secrets inside the container** — mount JSON secrets for Odoo modules. See [Local secrets](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/operations/secrets/).
- **CI image build and `ci` scenario** — baked runtime image alongside `developer` and `server`. See [ci scenario](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/scenarios/ci/).
- **Database state v1** — `.odpm/database/last_run.json` fingerprints PostgreSQL configuration, drift detection, `odpm database status` / `ensure-role`, legacy adoption baseline. See [Database state](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/reference/database-state/).
- **Full user documentation** (MkDocs, RU + EN). See [Documentation hub](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/).
- **Binary packages** — `.deb` and `.rpm` on GitHub Releases; APT/YUM repos for upgrades. See [Installing odpm](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/en/install/).

**Since 4.3-rc1**

- Database state v1 with drift resolution and legacy PostgreSQL adoption.
- Fix `--db-drop` when the Odoo database owner differs from the application role.

**Version note:** release **4.3.0**; the **`odpm.json` manifest format** (`odpm_version`) and **`odpm --version`** remain on the **4.0** compatibility line.

#### Install

| Platform | Package |
|----------|---------|
| Debian/Ubuntu | `odpm_4.3.0-1_all.deb` |
| Fedora 41+ | `odpm-4.3.0-1.fc41.noarch.rpm` (or `odpm-4.3.0-1.*.noarch.rpm` on your distro) |

Verify checksums with `SHA256SUMS` from this release.

```bash
# Debian/Ubuntu
sudo apt install ./odpm_4.3.0-1_all.deb

# Fedora
sudo dnf install ./odpm-4.3.0-1*.noarch.rpm
```

### Русский

Стабильный релиз линии **4.3** (после 4.3-rc1).

**Основные новшества**

- **Ускорено клонирование платформы Odoo** — shallow clone по ветке, коммиту или ограниченной глубине (экономия до ~40 минут).
- **`uv` на Debian 12+** в образах контейнера вместо `pip` — до ~10× быстрее установка пакетов. См. [сценарий developer](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/scenarios/developer/).
- **Настраиваемый источник платформы Odoo** — свой git URL; по умолчанию официальный GitHub Odoo. См. [Свой репозиторий платформы](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/scenarios/platform-fork/).
- **Dry-run (`odpm plan`)** — предпросмотр изменений до полного запуска. См. [CLI](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/reference/cli/).
- **Несколько backend'ов отладчика** — VS Code и **PyCharm**. См. [Отладка в IDE](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/operations/vscode-debug/).
- **Подстановка `${VAR}` в manifest** — переменные окружения в настройках. См. [odpm.json](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/reference/odpm-json/).
- **Секреты внутри контейнера** — JSON-секреты для модулей Odoo. См. [Локальные секреты](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/operations/secrets/).
- **Сборка CI-образа и сценарий `ci`**. См. [сценарий ci](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/scenarios/ci/).
- **Database state v1** — снимок конфигурации PostgreSQL, drift, `odpm database status` / `ensure-role`, adoption для legacy-кластеров. См. [Database state](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/reference/database-state/).
- **Полная документация** (MkDocs, RU + EN). См. [Документация](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/).
- **Бинарные пакеты** — `.deb` и `.rpm` на GitHub Releases; APT/YUM-репозитории. См. [Установка odpm](https://aayartsev.github.io/odpm/stable/install/).

**С 4.3-rc1**

- Database state v1 с разрешением drift и adoption legacy PostgreSQL.
- Исправлен `--db-drop`, когда владелец БД Odoo отличается от роли приложения.

Релиз **4.3.0**; формат **`odpm.json`** (`odpm_version`) и **`odpm --version`** остаются на линии **4.0**.

#### Установка

| Платформа | Пакет |
|----------|---------|
| Debian/Ubuntu | `odpm_4.3.0-1_all.deb` |
| Fedora 41+ | `odpm-4.3.0-1.fc41.noarch.rpm` |

Сверяйте checksum по `SHA256SUMS` из этого релиза.

```bash
# Debian/Ubuntu
sudo apt install ./odpm_4.3.0-1_all.deb

# Fedora
sudo dnf install ./odpm-4.3.0-1*.noarch.rpm
```
